# 修改脸库信息
##### 简要描述

- 1.GroupName取值为”WhiteList”,”BlackList”,”VisitorList”

**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| <span class="colour" style="color:black">字段</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">类型</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">描述</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">是否必须</span> |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| GroupID | integer | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">人脸库ID，从0开始</span> | 是<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| GroupName | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">作为输入参数,脸库名字，最大长度32，不可为空</span><span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| Version | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">脸库版本号，最大长度32，可为空，设备端该字段暂未使用到</span><span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/1/ModifyList HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: dcfdd48c-4658-48ae-ae13-79b81cdcd60e
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 210

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceGroupList>
<FaceGroup>
<GroupID>0</GroupID>
<GroupName>WhiteList</GroupName>
<Version></Version>
</FaceGroup>
</FaceGroupList>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 189

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/1/ModifyList</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```
